for suffix in ['stdout','stderr']:
    b=data[dpath/f'producer.{suffix}.txt'];assert len(b)==r[f'producer_{suffix}_bytes'] and hashlib.sha256(b).hexdigest()==r[f'producer_{suffix}_sha256']

g=verify_gzip(data[ppath/(stem+'.tsv.gz')],canonical_size=s['canonical_bytes'],canonical_sha256=s['canonical_sha256'],gzip_size=s['gzip_bytes'],gzip_sha256=s['gzip_sha256'])

assert len(rows)==16384 and [int(line.split(b'\t',1)[0]) for line in rows]==list(range(16384))
primary=constructed_framing(out,source,host)
assert hashlib.sha256(primary).hexdigest()==r['primary_sha256']
p=parse_primary_log(primary,PrimaryIdentity(source,host,run,attempt),ctest_exit_code=8,expected_scope='synthetic')

logs=(base/('GREEN_'+host+'_job.log')).read_text()
receipts=[json.loads(line[line.index('{'):]) for line in logs.splitlines() if '"stage": "complete"' in line and '"producer_exit"' in line]
assert receipts==[r]
print(json.dumps({'result':'PASS','host':host,'source_commit':source,'run_id':run,'scope':'actual downloaded 5 files, strict status, primary reconstruction, gzip/hash/all-row-index validation; no local numerical replay','raw_primary_records':39,'canonical_row_indices':16384,'primary_evidence_state':p.evidence_state,'canonical_header':canonical.splitlines()[:3][0].decode(),'files':[{'path':str(p.relative_to(root)),'bytes':len(data[p]),'sha256':hashlib.sha256(data[p]).hexdigest()} for p in sorted(expected)],'receipt':r,'status':s,'outer_archive_digest':'GitHub-reported metadata only; member bytes independently verified against actual hosted receipt'},indent=2))
